title: FlexRotor: design of the compliant tine disc coupling of a power harrow rotor from rotor geometry and soil bin records
description: C++17 library and command-line program that designs the compliant tine disc coupling of a power harrow rotor. Calibration path: soil resistance torque from raw soil bin records, disc model with dry friction and end stops, identification, mean-load model. Design path: selection rule, torsion spring after EN 13906-3 with static and fatigue checks, virtual soil bin test with a synthetic soil load, tine paths, clearance and uncut soil element of a rotor row. Includes the soil bin records of the SGGW prototype rotor.
